metadata.description: The @dereekb/llm/openai entry (rollup, inferred from rollup.config.cjs): compiles into dist/packages/llm/openai and is named by the parent's `./openai` export. An explicit edge to llm:build-base, NOT `^build`: `^build` would resolve to llm:build, which depends on this very target -- a hard cycle. The edge holds even before this entry imports @dereekb/llm, because llm:build-base deletes the dist directory this entry writes into. A sibling entry it imports adds `{ projects: [<sibling>], target: build-base }`; another family (e.g. util) adds that family's ROOT `build`. The parent's `build` aggregates this target, so the entry has no `build` of its own.

Type-checks the llm-openai entry's specs and, through them and the spec config's src/**/*.ts include, every lib file of the entry. Vitest strips types, so without this target a type error in a llm-openai spec passes lint, tests and build. Run by the dbx-claude test and commit gate; never part of build. The lib config is left out for the same reason as llm:typecheck: util's Node-typed sources do not compile under the browser entries' types: [].
